evidence_quotes.quote: 120 hours of continuous riding on a single charge with full GPS (All Systems), 70 hours in Dual-Frequency mode; 1 hour of direct sunlight generates up to 2 hours of extra ride time
Device weight 102g (mount 53g); dimensions 99.5 x 60.8 x 15.7 mm; 2.7-inch 64-color MIP touchscreen (400 x 240); 32GB storage; IP67 waterproof
Supports Shimano Di2 & SRAM AXS electronic shifting data and customizable Di2 hood button controls, ANT+ radar alerts, and native Intervals.icu two-way sync

adversarial_checks: Pricing & KR official MSRP verified: Global US MSRP $249 USD and official Korea Joyworks MSRP 429,000 KRW verified without confusing bundle pricing.
Navigation caveat audited: Explicitly noted that smart Google Maps rerouting depends on smartphone Bluetooth connection via COROS App while offline maps remain on-device.
Mount & ecosystem check: Confirmed Garmin quarter-turn compatibility, native Intervals.icu 2-way sync, and Di2/AXS hood button mapping; asin set to null per SM-02.
